title: Existence of exceptional systems in the fixed lifted integral coordinates
statement: For D,l,E, finite-type D.k-schemes X,Y, a separated finite-type D.k-morphism f:X→Y and a compactification c, there is an ordinary exceptional system adjoint with its actual pro-etale transport over ULift O_E and the lifted uniformizer, namely Nonempty (Systems l E c) [def-sf-exceptional-integral-reconstruction-interfaces]. No absolute separatedness is imposed on X or Y.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptionalIntegralSystemExistence
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) : Nonempty (Systems l E c)
